title: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing of a Proposed Rule Change To List and Trade Shares of the ARK 21Shares Bitcoin ETF Under BZX Rule 14.11(e)(4), Commodity-Based Trust Shares
summary: On 1 June 2022, the Federal Register published an SEC notice that Cboe BZX Exchange had filed a proposed rule change (File No. SR-CboeBZX-2022-031, filed 13 May 2022) to list and trade shares of the ARK 21Shares Bitcoin ETF under BZX Rule 14.11(e)(4), the exchange's Commodity-Based Trust Shares listing standard. The trust's sponsor is 21Shares US LLC, with ARK Investment Management LLC providing marketing services. Publication of the notice opened a public comment period under Exchange Act Section 19(b)(1), the first procedural step before the Commission could approve, disapprove, or open formal proceedings on the proposed listing; the notice itself takes no position on, and does not resolve, how the SEC will ultimately act on the proposal.
why_it_matters: This is the procedural first step the SEC required before it could approve, disapprove, or open formal proceedings on a proposed crypto exchange-traded product listing: publishing the exchange's proposal and inviting public comment. It does not itself approve or disapprove anything, and this notice does not address the proposal's eventual outcome.
